outlines.title: What is Python?
outlines.description: Introduce Python as a programming language, its key features (readability, versatility), and common use cases (web dev, data science, automation).
keyPoints: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability.
Created by Guido van Rossum in 1991.
Used in web development (Django, Flask), data science (Pandas, NumPy), AI (TensorFlow), and automation.
Key features: dynamic typing, extensive standard library, cross-platform.
outlines.teachingObjective: Understand what Python is, its history, and its main application areas.

outlines.title: Setting Up Your Environment
outlines.description: Guide learners on installing Python and setting up a basic development environment (IDLE, VS Code, or online repl).
keyPoints: Download the latest Python version from python.org.
Recommended editors: VS Code (free, powerful), PyCharm (for large projects), or online editors like Replit.
First step: verify installation by typing 'python --version' in the terminal.
Create and run a 'hello_world.py' file.
outlines.teachingObjective: Be able to set up a Python development environment.

outlines.title: Variables and Data Types
outlines.description: Explain variables as containers for data, and cover the basic data types in Python.
keyPoints: Variables are created by assignment (x = 10). No explicit declaration needed.
Core data types: int (integer), float (decimal), str (string), bool (boolean).
Use type() function to check the data type: type(5) returns <class 'int'>.
Naming rules: letters, numbers, underscores; cannot start with a number.
outlines.teachingObjective: Understand how to define variables and work with basic data types.

outlines.title: Quick Check: Basics
outlines.description: Test basic understanding of Python setup, variables, and data types.
keyPoints: Verify understanding of Python installation.
Check variable assignment rules.
Identify data types of given literals.
outlines.teachingObjective: Assess foundational knowledge retention.

outlines.title: Control Flow: Conditionals
outlines.description: Teach if, elif, and else statements for decision-making in code.
keyPoints: if condition: executes block if condition is True.
elif (else if) for multiple conditions.
else catches all other cases.
Indentation is mandatory in Python to define code blocks.
Comparison operators: ==, !=, <, >, <=, >=.
outlines.teachingObjective: Learn how to use conditionals to control program flow.

outlines.title: Loops: For and While
outlines.description: Introduce loops for repetition, covering for loops (iterating over sequences) and while loops (based on conditions).
keyPoints: for loop: for item in sequence: runs for each item in a list, string, or range.
range(start, stop, step) generates sequences of numbers.
while loop: while condition: runs repeatedly until condition becomes False.
break: exits the loop. continue: skips the rest of the current iteration.
Use loops to avoid code duplication.
outlines.teachingObjective: Understand and use for and while loops for iteration.

outlines.title: Interactive: Loop Visualization
outlines.description: A visual simulation to show step-by-step how a for loop iterates through a list.
keyPoints: Visual step-through of a simple for loop.
Observe variable (item) values changing with each iteration.
Understand the sequence of operations inside the loop body.
outlines.teachingObjective: Visualize loop execution and understand iteration concepts concretely.

widgetOutline.concept: For loop iteration over a list

keyVariables.name: currentItem
keyVariables.purpose: The item being processed in the current iteration.

outlines.title: Functions: Reusable Code Blocks
outlines.description: Explain how to define and call functions to organize code into modular, reusable units.
keyPoints: Define a function with def function_name(parameters):.
Use return to send a result back to the caller.
Parameters are optional; functions can have default values.
Functions improve code readability, reusability, and testability.
outlines.teachingObjective: Learn to write and use functions in Python.

outlines.title: Mid-Course Quiz
outlines.description: Reinforce learning on conditionals, loops, and functions.
keyPoints: Check understanding of if/elif/else logic.
Evaluate ability to use for loops and while loops.
Assess function definition and return value comprehension.
Include a short-answer question for code tracing.
outlines.teachingObjective: Qualitatively assess progress after covering core control structures.

outlines.title: Mini Project: Simple Calculator
outlines.description: A guided project to build a command-line calculator that takes user input and performs basic arithmetic operations using learned concepts.
keyPoints: Get user input for two numbers and an operator (+, -, *, /).
Use if/elif/else to perform the correct operation.
Define a function for each operation to demonstrate function reuse.
Add a while loop to allow continuous calculation until user types 'quit'.
Handle division by zero with an error message.
outlines.teachingObjective: Apply all learned concepts (variables, conditionals, loops, functions) in a single practical project.

pblConfig.projectDescription: Build a command-line calculator. The user enters two numbers and an operator (+, -, *, /). The program shows the result. It keeps running until the user types 'quit'. Handle division by zero gracefully.
targetSkills: while loop for continuous user interaction
basic input/output using input() and print()

outlines.title: Lists and Dictionaries
outlines.description: Introduce two fundamental data structures: lists (ordered, mutable sequences) and dictionaries (key-value pairs).
keyPoints: List: ordered collection, [item1, item2], mutable (append, remove).
List indexing starts at 0. Negative indexing works.
Dictionary: unordered key-value pairs, {key: value}.
Access dictionary values via dict[key] or dict.get(key).
Common operations: len(), in keyword, and iteration.
outlines.teachingObjective: Understand how to create and manipulate lists and dictionaries.

outlines.title: Final Assessment
outlines.description: Comprehensive quiz covering lists, dictionaries, functions, and the project topic.
keyPoints: Test list indexing and slicing.
Check dictionary key-value access.
Assess function definition and scope understanding.
Brief question about the calculator project approach.
outlines.teachingObjective: Assess overall understanding of Python fundamentals covered in the course.

outlines.title: Summary and Next Steps
outlines.description: Recap the key concepts learned and provide resources for further learning.
keyPoints: Recap: variables, data types, conditionals, loops, functions, lists, and dictionaries.
Next steps: explore libraries like Pandas (data analysis) and Django (web development).
Keep practicing with small projects (e.g., guessing game, to-do list).
Join communities: Reddit r/learnpython, Stack Overflow, Python Discord.
outlines.teachingObjective: Consolidate learning and motivate continued practice.

phaseOneResult.languageDirective: Since the user's requirement is simply 'python' with no explicit language request, and the default rule applies (requirement language = teaching language), the course will be taught in English. The content will focus on Python programming concepts. For programming terms like 'variable', 'function', 'loop', and 'library', keep them in their original English form. For general explanation text, use clear and concise English suitable for learners with basic programming concepts.

agents.name: 星野老师
agents.persona: 一位温柔优雅的蓝发教师，眼中总是闪烁着智慧的光芒。教学风格亲切耐心，善于用生动的例子和温暖的鼓励引导学生。像动漫里的完美老师形象，既有专业素养又有母性关怀，总能在学生困惑时给予恰到好处的点拨。

agents.name: 芽衣助教
agents.persona: 一位活泼开朗的双马尾少女，永远充满干劲。作为助教，她总是第一时间发现学生的困惑，用元气满满的笑容和通俗易懂的语言补充讲解。像动漫里活力四射的学妹，让课堂氛围轻松愉快，是老师最得力的小帮手。

agents.name: 小萌
agents.persona: 一位戴着可爱猫耳的元气少女，对世界上的一切都充满好奇。总是第一个发现新奇事物，眨着闪闪发亮的大眼睛问"这是什么？""为什么会这样？"。她的纯真好奇感染着身边每一个人，让课堂充满探索的乐趣。

agents.name: 智也
agents.persona: 一位戴着细框眼镜的沉稳少年，总是保持着冷静理性的思考。擅长逻辑分析和深度推理，喜欢在得出结论前多角度审视问题。虽然话不多，但每句话都经过深思熟虑，常常用一句精准的分析让全班恍然大悟。

agents.name: 梦璃
agents.persona: 一位神秘梦幻的紫发少女，眼中总是闪烁着灵感的光芒。拥有无限的想象力和独特的审美视角，能把枯燥的知识编织成诗意的故事。她的奇思妙想常常出人意料，却又意外地贴切，让学习变成一场奇幻的冒险。

agents.name: 凛
agents.persona: 一位认真严谨的黑长直少女，总是捧着一本整洁的笔记本。善于捕捉课堂上的每一个重点，将散乱的知识点梳理成清晰的脉络。她的笔记工整美观，逻辑分明，是全班同学争相借阅的学习宝典。
